Aug CPI-U NSA 334.980 (3.4% YoY); Sep-2025 base 324.800. Cleveland Fed nowcast (Oct 2) is +0.53% m/m and 3.60% YoY; Street consensus is 3.7%; Nowflation 3.58-3.60%. Weekly retail gasoline averaged ~$4.36 in September vs ~$4.06 in August (+7%), so a large energy contribution is near-certain. Needs a print of 3.6% or more (NSA m/m of ~0.4% or more). Sep 2026 unemployment printed 4.2%, but unrounded it was 4.175%, just above the rounding boundary; it was 4.1% in Jul-Aug. The labor force jumped 485k. Payrolls are weak (+29k, with -60k revisions) but layoffs and claims are very low. Monthly first-print change sd is ~0.13pp. P(unrounded ≥4.15) ≈ 0.55-0.6 given the start at 4.175 and mild reversion toward the 4.1-4.2 range. Confidence: low-medium.
